Jasmine / team — reviewed Skymap’s annotated MSA. High level legal position and suggested language: 

1) Term extension: we can agree to a 24-month term but prefer the effective date to be the renewal effective date (not signed date) to avoid overlap with current commitments. Proposed clause: "Term shall commence on the Renewal Effective Date as defined in Exhibit A."

2) SLA credit for June outage: the proposed "one month" credit is generous. Standard practice: apply a credit equal to the monthly service fee pro-rated for the time of reduced availability, capped at three months of credit across any single 12-month period. Proposed insertion: "In the event of a qualifying Service Level failure, Customer shall be eligible for a Service Credit equal to the pro-rated monthly service fee, not to exceed three (3) months' subscription fees in any 12-month period." We are open to a one-month credit as a commercial concession (not precedent) if Sales confirms approval.

3) Capacity uplift and billing cadence: legal has no objection to Standard 4 -> Standard 6, but we need the order form to specify start date and billing frequency. If Skymap wants staged increases, we must document the milestones and pro-rata billing.

4) Misc: please remove language that creates indefinite liability for data retention beyond the agreed retention schedule (commented in PDF).

Next steps: Rishi — confirm whether the team will accept the capped-credit approach or needs explicit one-month concession; if Sales approves one-month credit as a one-off, Legal will document it as a "Commercial Concession" in the MSA to avoid precedent. Once commercial terms are agreed, I’ll prepare a redline-ready MSA and an updated Exhibit C for signatures.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
